tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap copied 251 in-cone source files, did the Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite, and seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md + TODO[migrate-NNN] markers (session-log.txt mapping table and TODO grep).

tools_problematic.problem: Only copies files physically under -Source; it ignored the sample's linked shared sources referenced via <Compile Include="$(SharedContentDir)\..."> + <Link>, so the entire SDKTemplate.Logging helper set (LogView, MediaPlayerLogger, MediaSourceLogger, MediaPlaybackItemLogger, AdaptiveMediaSourceLogger, extensions) never entered the project.
tools_problematic.evidence: UWP csproj has 15 <Compile Include="$(SharedContentDir)\cs\Logging\..."> items; migration-score.json winui_build_error: CS0234 missing 'SDKTemplate.Logging', CS0246 missing those logger types.

tool_limitations.limitation: No handling of MSBuild $(SharedContentDir) / GetDirectoryNameOfFileAbove linked-include sources that live outside the project directory.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Parse the UWP .csproj for <Compile/Page/...Include> items carrying a <Link>, expand the MSBuild expression, and copy each into the project cone at its link path (skip if a scaffold file already exists).

failed_apis.why_tried: Scenario3 RequestModification and other scenarios use Windows.Web.Http for adaptive-source request modification.
failed_apis.root_cause: Under WinUI 3, System.Net.Http is also in scope so these type names are ambiguous (CS0104); the skill's CS0104 guidance only covered XAML LaunchActivatedEventArgs.
failed_apis.fix: Fully qualify or alias to Windows.Web.Http for files that touch IHttpFilter/HttpBaseProtocolFilter/AdaptiveMediaSource.

failed_apis.why_tried: AddAuthorizationHeaderFilter implements IHttpFilter for PlayReady key requests.
failed_apis.root_cause: CS0535 — the implementation's SendRequestAsync signature drifted off Windows.Web.Http types (downstream of the CS0104 ambiguity 'fix').
failed_apis.fix: Keep all IHttpFilter member types in Windows.Web.Http; return IAsyncOperationWithProgress<HttpResponseMessage, HttpProgress>.

doc_errors.wrong: Lumps all explicit <Compile Include> items as 'drop / do not copy', with no guidance that <Link>ed shared sources outside the project cone must still be materialized somewhere.
doc_errors.correct: Linked shared sources must be brought into the project cone (now auto-harvested by the bootstrap); they are not the same as the UWP-only csproj markers you drop.

doc_errors.wrong: CS0104 section only addressed Windows.UI.Xaml vs Microsoft.UI.Xaml type clashes.
doc_errors.correct: The most common CS0104 in networking samples is Windows.Web.Http vs System.Net.Http (HttpClient/HttpRequestMessage/HttpResponseMessage).

special_apis.special_handling: Resolve the MSBuild expression and copy each <Link> item into the project cone so default globbing compiles it.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: namespace 'Logging' does not exist in 'SDKTemplate'
errors_encountered.root_cause: SharedContent\cs\Logging\*.cs were referenced via <Compile Include="$(SharedContentDir)..."><Link> and never copied into the project; SDK-style globbing can't see files outside the project directory.
errors_encountered.fix: Bootstrap now harvests linked shared sources into the project cone.

errors_encountered.error: CS0246: type 'LogView'/'MediaPlayerLogger'/'MediaSourceLogger'/'MediaPlaybackItemLogger'/'AdaptiveMediaSourceLogger' could not be found
errors_encountered.fix: Same — harvest the linked Logging helper set.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Both HTTP stacks in scope on WinUI 3; skill lacked the pattern.
errors_encountered.fix: Added CS0104 Windows.Web.Http pattern (qualify/alias to Windows.Web.Http for IHttpFilter/AdaptiveMediaSource code).

errors_encountered.error: CS0535: AddAuthorizationHeaderFilter does not implement IHttpFilter.SendRequestAsync
errors_encountered.root_cause: Filter signature moved off Windows.Web.Http types while resolving CS0104.
errors_encountered.fix: Documented: keep all IHttpFilter member types on Windows.Web.Http.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App does not compile; every SDKTemplate.Logging type and every logger class unresolved across Scenario2-7 and ContentSelector/PlayReadyHelper.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap did not harvest linked shared-content sources, and the skill never told the agent that $(SharedContentDir) <Link> files must be materialized. The agent even mapped obj\x64\Debug\Shared\Logging\*.g.cs (stale generated copies) instead of the real source.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Tier-1 bootstrap harvest of <Link>ed shared sources (implemented) + csproj-section note.

missing_tooling.need: Automatic materialization of MSBuild-linked shared-content source files into the project cone.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire build — 7/7 features failed solely because the shared logging assembly was absent.
